articles.title: Japanese, Korean banks see massive EPS upgrades while India lags: Jefferies
articles.summary: Jefferies noted FY27 consensus earnings-per-share (EPS) estimates for Japanese financials rose 19% and those for Korean financials increased 18% between December 2025 and September 2026, compared with just 1% for India.

articles.title: HDFC Bank appoints Jimmy Tata as Executive Director: Who is he?
articles.summary: Jimmy Tata is currently HDFC Bank’s Chief Credit Officer. He holds a Master of Financial Management from the Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management and is also a Chartered Financial Analyst from the Institute of Chartered Financial Analysts of India.

articles.title: Brics nations to have a common currency? Here’s what MEA said
articles.summary: Brics nations are discussing local currency trade settlements to reduce transaction costs. There is currently no proposal for a common Brics currency among member states. This initiative aims to complement existing global payment systems and improve trade efficiency.

articles.title: Canada 'wants to make a deal very badly,' says Donald Trump
articles.summary: President Trump stated Canada desires a trade deal soon and wants farmers treated better. He also expressed a wish for Ireland to be unified eventually. Trump met with Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin and President Catherine Connolly.

articles.title: Oil shock meets bond-market stress: Why 2026 is starting to resemble 2008 — but for different reasons
articles.summary: Oil prices are feeding directly into inflation expectations and government bond yields, creating a 2026 market shock that echoes 2008 but has a very different trigger.

articles.title: From Russian miniatures to African beads: The BRICS Bazaar taking over Delhi
articles.summary: BRICS Bazaar 2026 in Delhi brings crafts from 18 countries together, featuring Russian miniature art, African beadwork, Indian handicrafts and a vibrant celebration of global culture.

articles.title: RBI rejects Tata Sons’ CIC deregistration bid, makes stock market listing mandatory: Report
articles.summary: In a letter dated September 11, 2026, the central bank informed Tata Sons that its application for voluntary surrender from the CIC category could not be accepted.

articles.title: 1,212 pillars, 22 sacred wells: The temple behind the BRICS photo
articles.summary: Ramanathaswamy Temple, known for its 1,212 pillars, 22 sacred wells and 1,200-metre corridors, takes the global spotlight as the striking backdrop to the BRICS photo.

articles.title: Russia partners Adani Defence, HAL, BDL for missiles, fighter upgrades, defence production: Report
articles.summary: Russia is deepening defence cooperation with India through partnerships with Adani Defence & Aerospace, HAL and BDL, with several missile and fighter-upgrade programmes underway.

articles.summary: India's data centre industry is poised for a substantial $90 billion opportunity by FY35, catalyzed by rising demand for construction, cooling, and power infrastructure. The surge in artificial intelligence will further heighten energy and cooling requirements.

articles.title: ‘Global South must become a global decision-maker’: PM Modi at BRICS Summit with Xi, Putin
articles.summary: PM Narendra Modi called for a greater role for the Global South in global decision-making as he opened the BRICS Summit in New Delhi in the presence of Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

articles.title: CAS closing price under review: Sebi proposes 2 options for expiry settlement
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is actively exploring modifications to how derivative settlement prices are calculated. Two alternative methods are currently up for review, inviting stakeholder feedback.

articles.title: Minor had Rs 1.17 crore interest income, father faced Rs 12.83 lakh penalty; what ITAT did
articles.summary: The ruling arose from the tax dispute involving a man in New Delhi. He filed his income tax return on November 4, 2022, reporting total income of Rs 8.43 crore. The case was subsequently reopened by the Income Tax Assessing Officer (AO) at Jhandewalan on March 22, 2025.

articles.title: Nvidia weighs $10 billion investment in Anthropic’s mega IPO: Report
articles.summary: Anthropic, an artificial intelligence firm, is gearing up for a landmark initial public offering that could reshape the tech landscape. Reports indicate that Nvidia is eyeing a sizable investment in this IPO, which could fortify their strategic partnership.

articles.title: SP Group chairman Shapoor Mistry seeks ₹25,000 crore from Tata Sons over next two years: Report
articles.summary: Shapoor Mistry had been in talks with Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran and Noel Tata on the stake monetisation until July.

articles.title: Ice cream to defence: How Canada’s tariff war with US is boosting local businesses
articles.summary: Canadian businesses are experiencing increased sales due to a 'buy Canadian' movement. Local ice cream and gift shops report significant sales boosts from consumers. Wineries also saw demand rise after American alcohol was removed from shelves.

articles.title: US diesel prices at record $6: American farmers feel the heat as harvest season begins
articles.summary: With diesel prices hitting unprecedented levels, US farmers are grappling with steep fuel expenses that have doubled. This dramatic rise is disrupting essential operations for corn and soybean harvests, jeopardizing profitability and financial health.

articles.title: Apple iPhone Duo: No Face ID, hidden camera and more features you need to know
articles.summary: Apple iPhone Duo brings a ₹2.99 lakh foldable design with Touch ID instead of Face ID, eSIM-only support, split-screen iOS 27 and a hidden under-display selfie camera.

articles.title: Unified BRICS payment system is achievable, but trust is key hurdle: BRICS Business Council chair
articles.summary: Ziaad Suleiman of the BRICS Business Council said a unified payment system for the 11-member grouping is achievable, but countries must first establish trust, data-security safeguards and an appropriate regulatory framework.

articles.summary: In a bold move for India's tech sector, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has unveiled a federated industry platform designed to amplify the industry's global presence.

articles.summary: Coforge has experienced a shakeup as independent director DK Singh resigns amid tensions over the board’s strategy. His departure follows the resignation of chairman OP Bhatt, sparked by an internal audit that uncovered issues with the evaluation report.

articles.summary: On Friday, US stocks saw a rise, buoyed by a decline in oil prices and inflation data that matched analysts' projections. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite both recorded gains, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average also improved.

articles.summary: The meeting was held hours after Pezeshkian arrived in the national capital for the summit and marked his first visit to India as Iranian president.

articles.summary: SBI Research said it expects 50 bps of cumulative rate hikes by December, arguing that the RBI needs to act before temporary price pressures become entrenched.

articles.title: India’s forex reserves jump $44.9 billion to record $785.71 billion
articles.summary: Foreign currency assets (FCA), the largest component of India’s forex reserves, rose by $47.498 billion during the week to $648.17 billion, accounting for the bulk of the overall increase.

articles.title: IMF says new statistical series could improve India GDP estimates; fresh forecast due in October WEO
articles.summary: IMF Director of Communications Julie Kozack said India’s real GDP grew 7.8% in the second quarter, above both the IMF staff’s expectations and consensus estimates.

articles.summary: At the BRICS Business Forum in New Delhi, PM Narendra Modi urged BRICS members to identify and remove their top trade barriers and strengthen maritime security to ensure smoother cross-border commerce.
